description: The Naval Supply Systems Command Fleet Logistics Center (NAVSUP FLCSI) Detachment Naples intends to issue a solicitation in the near future for award in accordance with FAR Part 15 procedures. The solicitation will include instructions for submitting proposals and inquiries. A formal solicitation will be posted electronically on the System for Award Management (https://www.SAM.gov). The anticipated solicitation number will be N6817126RN003.
